text:
naomi: Quick thread on tenant-aware rollouts. Customer asked for an opt-in that can be immediately killed per-tenant without affecting global traffic. want to capture constraints and book owners.

devon: +1. key asks: per-tenant kill-switch, SLA-aware routing (paying enterprise tenants routed to dedicated pool first), and cost-throttle to avoid unexpected GPU spend.

paul_cust: from the customer side: we need a hard kill that guarantees requests go to fallback v1 until we give the green. no blurry partial degradation. also need audit logs for every toggle.

product-ops: agree. propose three layers: (A) tenant flag (instant kill), (B) regional routing fallback, (C) cost-throttle policy that caps QPS per tenant. all surfaced in console + webhook audit.

sre-lead: operational notes: kill-switch must be synchronous and push a route update to edge within 500ms. fallback mapping should prefer local compatible variant; if not available, route to shared fallback in same region. plan to use existing routing table service with a TTL flush.

naomi: sketching a minimal config for the feature flag and controls. will attach as PR after we align.

```
flag: tenant_shutdown_v2
applies_to: [tenant_id]
controls:
  - type: hard_kill
    immediate: true
    audit: true
  - type: fallback_route
    order: [local_variant, degraded_quantized, regional_shared]
  - type: sla_routing
    condition: tenant.sla == "enterprise"
    route_to: dedicated_pool
  - type: cost_throttle
    qps_limit: 5
    burst: 20
```

devon: curious about experiments: we should allow a small A/B cohort inside the tenant (10% of requests) to run model-v2 for metrics collection while default stays on v1. that helps quality gates without exposing all users.

product-ops: good point. add an opt-in experiment flag nested under the tenant flag. default off.

sre-lead: fallback behavior note: when TTL flush fails, we must denylist the tenant to avoid routing ambiguity and page on-call. denylist should be a last-resort safety with clear runbook.

paul_cust: audit requirements: who toggled, previous state, reason, ticket id, and timestamp. these need to be queryable via API.

naomi: action items: (1) devon to prototype route API hook for immediate TTL flush (2) platform to add audit webhook + console UI card (3) SRE to write denylist runbook + pager mapping (4) product to confirm experiment UX with customer. timeline: MVP in 2 sprints for internal tenants, 3 for external.

deploy-bot: [automated] feature-flag create request received: tenant_shutdown_v2  requestor=naomi  status=pending

devon: i'll scope the prototype and send a PR with integration tests for TTL flush and fallback preference. tagging @sre-lead for review.

product-ops: will draft the console mockups and example audit webhook payload. will share tomorrow.

naomi: thanks everyone. keeping the kill-switch synchronous is non-negotiable per the customer. ping me for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
